title: Our Church Family Story

moral.lesson: Our church started small — just a few friends who loved Jesus. Now our church family is big! We sing, we learn, we help people, and we love each other. Jesus loves our church family.
moral.application: You are part of our church family. Jesus loves you!

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.
character: A diverse friendly church community of adults and children. Focus on kids, school, serving, and friendship — no pastors as the focus.

beats.scene: A small group of smiling friends gathering in a simple school room with folding chairs, and a friendly outdoor tent church nearby in the same sunny scene. Focus on people together loving Jesus. No banners, no flags, no text, no rainbows.
text: A long time ago, our church was very small.
Friends who loved Jesus met at a school… and even under a tent!
Jesus was with them. Jesus loves our church family!

beats.scene: Bright colorful children's ministry room with diverse kids singing and learning about Jesus; nearby, older kids gather joyfully. Solid-color clothing only — no rainbow clothes. No floating crayons or flames. No text on walls.
text: We sing. We play. We learn that Jesus loves us.
Big kids have fun with their friends at church too!

beats.scene: Sunny Christian school campus: kids with backpacks, teachers welcoming students, classmates laughing and learning together. Virginia Academy vibe. No text on signs.
text: Our church has a school too — Virginia Academy!
Jesus loves the kids at our school!

beats.scene: Volunteers packing food boxes and grocery bags for families, handing meals to neighbors with big smiles, kids helping carry bags. Friendly outdoor market-table / meal-giveaway scene. No text.
text: Our church helps people who need food.
We share bags of food with happy smiles.
Helping others is one way we love like Jesus!

beats.scene: Split joyful scene: friends talking and praying in a cozy living room; and church friends helping people in a warm hopeful community far away. Celebration of friendship near and far. No text.
text: Friends meet in little groups to pray and talk.
And our church helps people near and far away.
Jesus loves our church family — here and everywhere!
